title: Mountains of Ararat
summary: "The mountains of Ararat" where the Ark rested (Gen 8:4). Ararat is the biblical name for the region known as Urartu; Scripture names the range, not a specific peak.
coordinate_basis: OpenBible.info GeoJSON point m08a591 (modern identification "Urartu"); region-level, not a landing site.

certainty.basis: OpenBible.info: identification of the region Ararat with Urartu at "very high confidence". The exact Ark landing site within the region is unknown.

open_questions: The OpenBible Wikidata link Q185068 should be checked - confirm it refers to the Ararat/Urartu region and not Mount Ararat specifically.
